title: Schema artifact
description: The single source for the Perspective schema, key columns, colDefs and filter strategy for one datasource. Produced by an offline inference pass, reviewed by a human, versioned (architecture §4). Never auto-applied in production.

inferredFrom.description: Provenance. An artifact whose sample was too small to trust is a support ticket waiting to happen.

reviewedBy.description: Inference output is reviewable, never auto-applied (architecture §4.1). An unreviewed artifact should not reach production.

volatileSortColumns.description: Columns whose value churns and that users also sort on. Drives the SSRM sort-position-drift policy (parity study §5.3); default is to accept drift rather than refresh.

setFilterColumns.description: Only these pay the unseen-value check on the update path — not all 160 (parity study §1.3).

estimatedRows.description: Drives automatic mode selection (architecture §8.3) and admission accounting against the process ceiling (§6.2).

perspectiveType.description: Widen int->float on conflict, never narrow. Numeric-looking strings stay strings — CUSIP, SEDOL, ISIN and account numbers lose leading zeros or precision otherwise (architecture §4.1).

filterStrategy.description: Chosen from observed cardinality: <500 set eager · 500-10k set lazy · >10k search-select. AG-Grid ships the whole set-filter value list to the browser, so beyond ~10k the UX degrades regardless of virtualization (parity study §1.4).

id.description: Stable identifier. DSL rules reference this, not the display name, so renames do not break persisted rules (architecture §9.3).

path.description: Source path in the raw payload, before flattening.

cascadingValues.description: Opt-in per column. Every filter change invalidates N distinct-value caches, so enable only where traders expect it (parity study §1.5).

observed.description: Inference evidence. Kept so a reviewer can judge the call rather than trust it.

companion.description: Numeric twin for a display-formatted column. 32nds prices sort and aggregate through this (architecture §4.2).

colDef.description: Fragment merged into the generated AG-Grid ColDef. Deliberately open — AG-Grid 36 ColDef is large and pinning its shape here would duplicate their types.

sortColumn.description: Points at the companion column where one exists. Custom comparators are never called in SSRM (parity study §3), so sort ordering must live in the data.
